value: Warden Thelwater sends the adventurer into the prison riot and orders Bazil killed. The order is what this quest records; it is not a trial, and the story does not invent a speech from Bazil or a count of unnamed prisoners. The investigation has moved from a letter to testimony, then to violence carried out inside the state’s own prison.
editorNote: Represent the order and quest objective only; no unsupported prisoner dialogue or broader riot outcome is added.
